metadata.description: ATR (Agentic Test Runner) Claude Code skills and MCP server for browser automation and cross-platform desktop control

plugins.name: atr-skills
plugins.description: Skills: browser control + recording (atr-browser), cross-platform desktop control with in-process agent + multi-monitor support (atr-computer: mouse, keyboard, screen, windows, apps, 'computer ask' for natural-language tasks), run tests with AI analysis (atr-analyze), behavior testing (atr-behavior). MCP Server: 50+ tools (30 browser + 22 desktop) via 'atr mcp serve'
